From "The Big Gun" (Hodges). Navweaps: "probably refers to APC of the early World War I era, not the later, improved Greenboy projectiles"; 90 deg inclination. MV not stated.

Raven & Roberts: "based upon theoretical calculations performed in 1935, not actual firing trials". MV not stated (likely 2400 fps standard charge).
